subject: Follow-up: NovaCorp hosted API token + TPS forecast
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Chen <elaine.chen@novacorp.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: NovaCorp hosted API token + TPS forecast

Hi Elaine —

Thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and a couple of clarifying asks so we can put together a crisp pricing proposal and pilot SOW:  

What we heard on the call
- Primary use: in-product summarization + chat for support agents (hybrid prompts + generation).
- Target rollout: phased (pilot -> team -> organization).
- Current working estimate: broad range on monthly tokens and some peak concurrency concerns.

Clarifying asks (single-line answers appreciated):
1) Expected monthly token usage (approximate range or target point; include whether this is prompt-only, completion-only, or combined).
2) Peak TPS during business hours (observed or expected spikes).
3) Budget range or target $/1M tokens you’re trying to hit for hosted API charges.

Attached: Novacorp_initial_questions.xlsx (simple forecast template). If you can fill out the three items above we’ll return a pricing sheet with unit-econ scenarios (list pricing, committed-discounted pricing, and pilot credit math) and a recommended 30–60 day pilot configuration.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm the three items above (or drop a quick note here).
- We’ll send a tailored pricing sheet + SOW draft for a pilot that reflects the numbers.

Thanks — speak soon.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

[Attachment: Novacorp_initial_questions.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Elaine Chen <elaine.chen@novacorp.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novacorp.com
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 16:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: NovaCorp hosted API token + TPS forecast

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for the recap and the template. Answers below:

1) Expected monthly tokens: we expect ~95,000,000 tokens/month once the pilot reaches production cadence. That is combined prompt + completion. Our current internal logs show roughly 60% completion tokens, 40% prompts.

2) Peak TPS: our busiest windows currently spike to ~150–180 TPS (short bursts, ~5–10 minutes) when multiple agents load case histories; sustained peak across an hour is closer to 120 TPS.

3) Budget / target $/1M tokens: we are targeting the $2–$3 per 1M tokens range for hosted usage. Our procurement team has flexibility if we can show predictable cost savings (e.g., batching / caching) or commit to monthly minimums.

Attaching procurement requirements and a short internal note on SLA/compliance. Let me know the next price sketches and whether you need a confirmed traffic sample.

Best,
Elaine Chen
Head of Product Ops, NovaCorp
elaine.chen@novacorp.com

[Attachment: procurement_requirements.pdf (pdf)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Chen <elaine.chen@novacorp.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 18:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: NovaCorp hosted API token + TPS forecast

Hi Elaine — really helpful, thanks. A few immediate clarifications and an initial pricing sketch below:

Clarification request (quick):
- When you cite 95M tokens/month, can you confirm that is an "estimated billable token" number (i.e., combined prompt+completion) as opposed to "raw model tokens"? (You already said combined — just want to be precise for the SOW.)

Initial hosted API pricing sketch (ballpark; final in pricing sheet):
- List (no commit): $6.00 per 1M tokens (standard vetted models).
- Mid-tier (50M+ committed monthly): $3.50 per 1M tokens.
- High-volume (200M+ committed monthly): $2.00 per 1M tokens.
- Pilot offer: 60-day pilot priced at $3.00 per 1M tokens up to first 100M tokens, plus one-time $5k pilot credit to offset early tuning and eval costs.

Notes on unit economics and burst handling:
- Peak TPS: hosted API supports bursts, but sustained high TPS benefits from pre-warming and our burst pool; brief spikes (under ~10 minutes) are included in hosted service. For predictable 150+ TPS sustained windows we recommend either a short-term dedicated burst add-on or a pilot config with pre-warmed instances.
- Effective cost: you can materially lower effective $/1M via batching, prefix caching, and quantization-friendly model choices; Aisha can run a quick eval on a traffic sample to estimate realized tokens after batching.

Next steps I’ll take now:
1) Share a short pricing sheet + SOW draft that reflects your 95M number and the pilot offer (attaching NovaCorp_proposed_pricing_sheet.csv).
2) Aisha will reach out to request a 24–48 hour traffic sample (if you’re OK sharing) to validate token mix and TPS distribution.
3) If procurement is comfortable, we’ll prepare a 60-day pilot SOW and DocuSign link.

If the $2–$3 target is a hard constraint for procurement, tell us and we’ll model a committed discount bridge that gets you to $3.00 at 100M+ commitment. Hitting $2.00 typically requires a 200M+ commit or an enterprise reserved contract.

Thanks — forwarding the pricing sheet now.

— Vanessa

[Attachment: NovaCorp_proposed_pricing_sheet.csv (csv)]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 19:04:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Follow-up: NovaCorp hosted API token + TPS forecast

Vanessa / Aisha — quick internal note on pricing posture for NovaCorp:
- Elaine's target ($2–$3 / 1M) is reasonable to meet at scale; looks like 95M sits in the mid-tier discount zone.
- Recommend we lead with the 60-day pilot at $3.00/1M for up to 100M tokens + $5k credit. If traffic validates (Aisha’s eval) we can escalate to a 100M committed tier at $3.50 or offer a step-down to $3.00 on a 90–120 day cadence.
- If procurement pushes hard to $2.00, we should reserve that for a 200M+ committed Dedicated or Private deal — not for hosted list.

I'll prepare two short contract language options for the SOW (pilot -> conversion to committed) and pass to legal if Vanessa approves.

— Connor
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Elaine Chen <elaine.chen@novacorp.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novacorp.com
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: NovaCorp hosted API token + TPS forecast

Vanessa —

Thanks — that pricing sketch is clear and aligns with our internal expectations. Confirming the numbers below so you can finalize the SOW:
- Confirmed monthly tokens for pilot: 95,000,000 tokens/month (this is combined prompt+completion; figures are billable tokens).
- Confirmed expected bursts: short spikes to 150–180 TPS, sustained peaks near 120 TPS. We do not expect sustained 200+ TPS during the pilot.
- Procurement target: we can accept the pilot at $3.00 per 1M tokens for 60 days with the $5k onboarding credit. If the eval shows token reductions from batching/caching, we'll discuss committed tiers promptly.

Please send the DocuSign SOW and Aisha’s request for the traffic sample and we’ll get procurement looped in.

Best,
Elaine

[Attachment: signed_initial_ndas.pdf (pdf) referenced — procurement to follow if needed]
